meta.summary: Hides the Mylow chat button, feedback tab, store nudge, gam ad wrappers; blur or hide promo images; dim or hide recommendations
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, desktop UA on www.lowes.com (home page). **Only the desktop home page could be inspected**: after the first visit, lowes.com answered further automated requests (mobile UA, search and category pages) with a network error, so no mobile or product-page DOM was captured. The fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are both built from the one saved desktop home-page DOM (scripts and text stripped); the mobile site may differ.

- **Chat button** (LIVE, 1): `#luca-app`, the floating Ask Mylow assistant on the right edge.
- **Feedback tab** (LIVE, 1): `#kampyleButtonContainer`, the vertical survey tab.
- **Store nudge** (LIVE, 1): the Choose how you'll get your order bubble under the header, found through its close button (`aria-label`, English only) because its classes are hashed.
- **Ads** (existing option, +1 rule, LIVE 3): `[data-testid="gam"]`, the Google Ad Manager wrappers that surround the `google_ads_iframe` slots.
- **Promo images** choice (LIVE, 32 pictures in the unified column-control and scaled-image banners): blur or hide; headlines and links stay.
- **Recommendations** choice (LIVE, 3): the personalised dynamic-cards block and the recommendation carousel mount points; dim or hide. Logged out the carousel is mostly empty.
- **Recommended searches** (LIVE, 1): the pill row under the search box (`aria-label`, English only).

The three original rules were kept; the ad-slot rule matched 2 elements on the home page, the cookie and app-banner rules matched none. Not verified: product listing and product pages, cart, mobile layout, the sweepstakes pop-up mount point (`playwright-sweepstakes-opt-in-modal`, present but empty with no visible content).
